subject: Export to CSV drops the last row
body: When I export a board with more than 100 cards to CSV, the last row is missing from the file. Steps: open a board with 101 cards, choose Export, then CSV, and open the file in a spreadsheet. Expected 101 rows, got 100. Happens on both the web app and the desktop app.

about: A GitHub pull request opened, with a description.
subject: Speed up board loading
body: This change caches the board's columns between page loads and only refetches cards that changed. On a board with 400 cards the first paint goes from 2.1 seconds to 0.6 seconds. Tests cover the cache expiry and the case where a column is deleted while cached.

subject: Export boards to CSV with comments
body: It would help our team a lot if a board export could include each card's comments, not only the title and the fields. We send a weekly report to our clients and today we copy the comments by hand, which takes about an hour each Friday.

subject: Dark mode for the mobile app
body: Please add a dark mode to the mobile app. Several of us check the board late in the evening and the white background is very bright. The desktop app already follows the system setting, so matching that on the phone would be perfect.

body: When a bot asks for approval, I would love to approve or decline it straight from the Slack notification instead of opening the app. A button for each choice and a short note field would cover almost all of our approvals during the day.

body: Here is what is new this month: shared views now support filters, exports are twice as fast, and the mobile app has offline mode for checklists. We are also hosting a live Q and A on the 30th; reply to this email with your questions and we will cover as many as we can.
